item.title: Habitat Network — Traditional Orchard source files
item.subtitle: Biodiversity & Habitats / Ulster Wildlife
item.description: Spatial extent of traditional orchard habitat across Northern Ireland, classified into Existing Habitat, Associated Habitats, Network Enhancement Zones, Fragmentation Action Zones and Network Expansion Zones. Part of the Nature Recovery NI habitat-network mapping project published by Ulster Wildlife on Open Data NI.

references.label: Open Data NI — Traditional Orchard Habitat Network
